## Pull request overview

Adds a small library of single-purpose Opentrons OT-2 protocols to make troubleshooting and “manual-style” motion checks easier without writing full protocols, using a consistent deck layout and a tunable-constants block pattern.

**Changes:**
- Introduces `ot2-protocols/` with six focused OT-2 protocols (tip handling, XY moves, Z moves, plate-corner visits, aspirate/dispense, home/park).
- Documents the shared deck setup and the tunable-variable convention in `ot2-protocols/README.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ot2-protocols/README.md | Documents common deck layout, tunable constants convention, and how to run/simulate protocols. |
| ot2-protocols/01_pick_up_and_return_tip.py | Minimal tip pickup/return motion check. |
| ot2-protocols/02_move_to_well_and_back.py | Moves between two specified wells with a pause for visual alignment checks. |
| ot2-protocols/03_move_pipette_down.py | Z-axis “move down by distance” inspection protocol (needs safety validation). |
| ot2-protocols/04_visit_plate_corners.py | Visits corner wells to exercise XY limits. |
| ot2-protocols/05_aspirate_dispense_test.py | Minimal liquid handling sanity check (should validate volume). |
| ot2-protocols/06_home_and_park.py | Homes axes and optionally parks above a slot (should validate slot selection). |
</details>
@copilot This looks great! We'll test it and get back to you with feedback. However, our pipette is loaded in the left mount, not the right mount. Change that and we'll get it tested!

@copilot I'm getting errors calibrating the wireless color sensor. 

One possibility is version difference. Our OT-2 is running v9 of opentrons software, meaning it might require some extra parameters, like tip overlap. Research v9 and any changes they made in the update, then list the relevant updates and necessary changes. Then make the necessary changes to the json file.

## Pull request overview

Adds a new research markdown document to the repo root that evaluates OT-2 overhead camera hardware options (gantry-mounted “fake pipette” vs fixed overhead through the lid) and outlines integration considerations with the existing MQTT/S3 + `picamera2` workflow.

**Changes:**
- Introduces a detailed camera options comparison with working-distance/FOV math, pixels-per-well estimates, and costed configurations.
- Documents mounting approaches (gantry-mounted vs fixed overhead) and provides procurement guidance (including a DigiKey-focused BOM).
- Summarizes lighting/low-light tradeoffs and practical recommendations.
